About the Fellowship

Cincinnati's Dean's Dissertation Completion Fellowship supports current doctoral students approaching the end of their dissertation. It is an internal award with a nomination deadline, not a funded place for new applicants starting a PhD.

Research Areas

  • Dissertation completion
  • Doctoral research
  • Research writing

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionInternal doctoral fellowship
Stipend / salaryUSD 12,500/semester; up to USD 25,000 for two semesters

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityCurrent University of Cincinnati PhD students
Further conditionsExisting Cincinnati doctoral students approaching dissertation completion.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen: internal nomination
Deadline / consideration round1 December 2026, 23:59 (nomination)
LocationUnited States
Details checked9 October 2026

How to Apply

  1. Confirm your eligibility as a current doctoral student and review the internal award requirements.
  2. Follow the university’s nomination process and arrange the supporting materials requested by your programme.
  3. Complete the internal submission by the nomination deadline and arrange reference submissions where required.

About University of Cincinnati

Cincinnati offers doctoral study through its graduate programmes. Its dissertation completion fellowship supports selected current doctoral students, with nominations and award decisions coordinated through the Graduate College.
